content.value_statement: Manual contract emission interrupts development and can leave production artifacts outdated. This skill configures supported Vite automation and explicit build steps for other tools.
actual_capabilities: Installs and configures the Prisma Next Vite contract emission plugin.
Supports Vite 7 and Vite 8 development workflows.
Configures debounce and logging options for contract emission.
Adds explicit contract emission before CI and production builds.
Integrates the plugin with React Router framework mode.
Explains workarounds for unsupported bundlers and older Vite versions.
limitations: The Vite plugin does not emit contracts during Vite production builds.
Vite 6 and earlier versions are not supported.
First-party plugins for Next.js, Webpack, esbuild, Rollup, and Turbopack are unavailable.
The skill does not configure Prisma Next runtime middleware.

use_cases.title: Automate Vite Development
use_cases.description: Configure automatic contract emission when Prisma contract sources change during Vite development.

use_cases.title: Prepare Reliable CI Builds
use_cases.description: Add an explicit prebuild step so generated contract artifacts are current before production compilation.

use_cases.title: Plan Unsupported Integrations
use_cases.description: Identify supported alternatives and canonical APIs when a project uses Next.js or another unsupported bundler.

prompt_templates.title: Add the Vite Plugin
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure Prisma Next contract emission in my Vite 8 project. Use the existing package manager and explain each changed file.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs the standard supported setup.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Contract Refresh
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Vite configuration and verify that Prisma Next contracts re-emit after source changes. Diagnose any config-only watching warning.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer has an incomplete or failing development loop.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate React Router
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Prisma Next contract emission to my React Router v7 framework project. Preserve existing Vite plugins and include verification steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: A project combines React Router framework mode with Prisma Next.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Cross-Bundler Build Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess my non-Vite build system and design Prisma Next contract emission for development and CI. Use supported APIs and state unsupported features.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a documented workaround for another bundler.

output_examples.input: Add Prisma Next contract emission to a Vite 8 application.
output: The required development dependency is identified for the current package manager.
The Vite configuration points to the Prisma Next configuration file.
A verification sequence confirms initial emission and refresh after source edits.

output_examples.input: Make contract generation reliable in production builds.
output_examples.output: The build workflow runs contract emission before compilation and explains why the development plugin alone is insufficient.

output_examples.input: Configure Prisma Next for a Next.js project.
output_examples.output: The response states that no first-party Next.js plugin exists and provides explicit development and prebuild alternatives.

best_practices: Point the plugin to the Prisma Next configuration file, not directly to the contract source.
Keep committed logging at the information level and enable debug output only during troubleshooting.
Run explicit contract emission before CI and production builds.
anti_patterns: Do not expect the development plugin to run during Vite production builds.
Do not invent first-party plugins for unsupported bundlers.
Do not use the Vite plugin with unsupported Vite versions.

faq.question: Which Vite versions are supported?
faq.answer: The plugin supports Vite 7 and Vite 8.

faq.question: Does the plugin run during Vite production builds?
faq.answer: No. Add explicit Prisma Next contract emission before the production build.

faq.question: Which file path does the plugin receive?
faq.answer: Pass the Prisma Next configuration path relative to the Vite root.

faq.question: Can this skill configure React Router framework mode?
faq.answer: Yes. It can place the Prisma Next and React Router plugins in the same Vite configuration.

faq.question: Is there a first-party Next.js plugin?
faq.answer: No. Use manual development emission and an explicit prebuild command.

faq.question: What does config-only watching mean?
faq.answer: The plugin could not resolve contract inputs. Fix configuration loading and ensure the source path is inside the Vite root.
